title: Handle authenticated login and completed setup routes with clear terminal states
description:
Problem: the continued live review found `/login` still presenting a full sign-in form while the authenticated app chrome showed a signed-in session, and `/admin/setup` showing a completed-setup card beneath an empty-looking header strip. These terminal auth/setup routes are valid compatibility states, but the current UI can feel contradictory or unfinished.

Desired outcome: auth and setup terminal routes should make the current state obvious and route users to the next appropriate action without showing stale or contradictory forms.

Scope:
- In scope: `/login` when already authenticated, `/admin/setup` when setup is already complete, visible page titles/status regions, redirect-or-status-card behavior, and accessible labels for terminal-state actions.
- Out of scope: changing authentication providers, setup persistence, or first-run bootstrap semantics.

Acceptance criteria:
- Authenticated users visiting `/login` are redirected or shown a signed-in state with clear actions such as open app/profile or sign out.
- Completed setup visits to `/admin/setup` show an intentional terminal state without an empty header strip.
- The visible UI and accessibility tree agree on the page purpose.
- Browser checks cover authenticated `/login` and completed `/admin/setup` states.

Validation:
- Capture `/login` while authenticated and unauthenticated where feasible.
- Capture `/admin/setup` after setup is complete.
- Run focused browser route checks for the terminal states and action labels.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Created from 2026-05-25 continued live review: `/login` showed a sign-in form under authenticated chrome, and `/admin/setup` showed setup-complete content under an empty-looking header strip.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Implemented terminal-state branches for auth/setup routes. `/login` now uses an account-access header and shows an already-signed-in state with Open MemorySmith, Open profile, and Sign out actions for authenticated users while preserving the anonymous setup/sign-in flow. `/admin/setup` now uses a `Setup Complete` header and intentional terminal-state actions when first-admin setup is already complete. Validation: `dotnet build .\MemorySmith.App\MemorySmith.App.csproj --nologo` succeeded; a Playwright probe verified anonymous `/login` still shows the sign-in form and completed `/admin/setup` shows the new `Setup Complete` state; `MEMORYSMITH_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5099 npm run test:route-smoke` passed 5/5. The authenticated `/login` branch is compile/code-path validated but was not browser-probed locally because the validation browser had no credentials.
